issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares the field lectureName as type int, but the example toString and the solution implementation treat lectureName as a String. This mismatch between the UML (problem_statement.md) and the intended implementation (solution's Lecture.java) can confuse students when they add attributes and implement the constructor (they may be unsure whether lectureName should be int or String).
issues.suggestedFix: Update the UML/type declaration in problem_statement.md to declare lectureName as String (e.g. lectureName: String) so it matches the example toString and the intended implementation. Ensure the constructor description and any examples consistently use String for lectureName.
